name: Warehousing
need: Space to store goods safely and close to your customers.
solution: Secure, managed storage with inventory handling.

name: Third-party logistics (3PL)
need: Hand off day-to-day logistics without building your own team.
solution: Outsourced storage, handling and fulfilment under one partner.

name: Supply chain management
need: One view of goods moving from supplier to shelf.
solution: Planning and coordination across every leg of the chain.

name: Cold chain management
need: Keep perishable goods within the right temperature range.
solution: Temperature-controlled handling from pickup to delivery.

name: Temperature-controlled facilities
need: Storage that holds a set temperature.
solution: Cold rooms and controlled areas for sensitive goods.

name: Transport & distribution
need: Move goods by land, sea or air.

name: LCL collection hubs
need: Ship less than a full container.
solution: Collection points that consolidate smaller loads.

name: On-demand bookings
need: Flexible capacity when you need it.
solution: Service capability overview only in this phase; booking is out of scope.
